body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> COBY USA presented its 8-inch digital photo frame featuring mp3 player ''DP882'' during CES2007. It supports slide show with music and video playback (mp4 and AVI) as well.
